tools.name: get_pricing_capabilities
tools.description: Use this first, before quote_price or draft_order, when a user wants custom-printed index tab dividers (binder tabs, tab dividers, exhibit tabs, chart dividers) priced or ordered: returns the product (paper), every option key and choice id, valid set quantities, and ordering facts. Takes no input. Do not use for blank or write-on dividers, labels, or binders themselves.

tools.name: draft_order
tools.description: Use this when the user has their actual list of tab titles (section names, in order) and wants an order drafted: returns the exact price for that build plus an orderUrl that opens Tabzoola's designer with every title pre-filled, for a human to review and complete at checkout. Purchases nothing, reserves nothing, takes no payment; a free PDF proof is emailed before anything prints. Minimum 25 sets, 1-150 titles. Do not use for reverse-printed tabs, PMS ink, printing on the divider sheet or custom sheet sizes (quote only) or for anything other than custom-printed tab dividers.

titles.description: Tab titles in tab order, one per tab (1-150). The title count sets tabs-per-set.

options.description: Optional map of optionKey -> choiceId (see get_pricing_capabilities). Omitted options use defaults.

tools.name: list_named_sets
tools.description: Use this when the user names a kind of binder rather than listing titles (estate planning, trust, exhibit 1-25, medical chart, HOA, IEP, audit workpapers, real estate closing, and many more): returns Tabzoola's ready-made tab sets matching the query, each with its section titles in order, tabs per set, the page that describes it, the exact price for 25 sets (paper, collated, 3-hole punched, setup included) and an orderUrl that opens the designer pre-filled. Read-only; purchases nothing. Pass the titles to draft_order or quote_price for other quantities or options.

query.description: Words to match against set names, uses and titles, e.g. "estate", "exhibit", "hoa", "chart". Omit to list sets.

tools.name: quote_price
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a price for custom-printed tab dividers and knows the tabs per set and number of sets: returns exact per-set and total USD with setup included, plus an orderUrl that opens Tabzoola's configurator with this build pre-selected for a human to complete. Same engine as the website. Minimum 25 sets, 1-150 tabs per set. Do not use for reverse-printed tabs, PMS ink, printing on the divider sheet or custom sheet sizes (quote only), and never to charge anyone: it is read-only.

product.description: Product line (paper is the only product)

options.description: Optional map of optionKey -> choiceId (see get_pricing_capabilities). Omitted options use defaults.

colorChanges.description: Optional and ignored for price: tab colors mix freely at no extra charge
